exposure: Timing of labor induction (41+0 weeks vs. 41+3 weeks gestation)
cohort: Pregnant women with gestations > 40 weeks undergoing labor induction in 2019 (at 41+3 weeks) and 2021 (at 41+0 weeks).
finding: Induction of labor at 41+0 weeks compared to 41+3 weeks led to an increase in inductions and a decrease in antepartum visits and instrumental deliveries, with similar maternal and fetal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: Earlier induction at 41+0 weeks significantly reduced instrumental deliveries and increased the probability of eutocic delivery, with no significant differences in cesarean section rates.
gest_age: Pregnancies > 40 weeks, comparing induction at 41+0 weeks vs. 41+3 weeks.
